questions.title: Thread Sum of Squares Split
questions.description:
Read an integer n. Create two threads that split the range 1..n into two halves. Each thread computes the sum of squares of its half, then both threads return their partial results. Print the total.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n.

Output Format:
The integer sum of squares from 1 to n.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
half = (n + 1) / 2
t1 = Thread.new do
  s = 0
  (1..half).each { |x| s += x * x }
  s
end
t2 = Thread.new do
  s = 0
  ((half + 1)..n).each { |x| s += x * x }
  s
end
puts t1.value + t2.value

questions.title: Thread Value Join Return
questions.description:
Read two integers a and b. Spawn a single thread that computes a + b and returns it. Wait for the thread to finish, then print the value returned by the thread block.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer a. Line 2: integer b.

Output Format:
The integer sum a + b.

Constraints:
-1000 <= a, b <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
a = gets.to_i
b = gets.to_i
t = Thread.new { a + b }
t.join
puts t.value

questions.title: Mutex Shared Counter Increment
questions.description:
Read an integer n. Create n threads; each thread increments a shared counter by 1 exactly once under a mutex. Join all threads, then print the final counter value.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n (number of threads).

Output Format:
The final counter value (equals n).

Constraints:
0 <= n <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
m = Mutex.new
c = 0
threads = n.times.map do
  Thread.new do
    m.synchronize { c += 1 }
  end
end
threads.each(&:join)
puts c

questions.title: Queue Producer Consumer Sum
questions.description:
Read an integer n. Spawn a producer thread that pushes the numbers 1 through n into a Queue, then pushes nil as a sentinel. Spawn a consumer thread that pops items, summing them until nil. Join both threads, then print the sum.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n.

Output Format:
The sum 1 + 2 + ... + n.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
q = Queue.new
total = 0
mutex = Mutex.new
producer = Thread.new do
  (1..n).each { |i| q.push(i) }
  q.push(nil)
end
consumer = Thread.new do
  loop do
    v = q.pop
    break if v.nil?
    mutex.synchronize { total += v }
  end
end
producer.join
consumer.join
puts total

questions.title: Fiber Number Generator
questions.description:
Read an integer n. Use a Fiber that yields the integers 1, 2, ..., n one at a time. Resume the fiber repeatedly and print each yielded value on its own line.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n.

Output Format:
n lines, each containing one integer from 1 to n.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
f = Fiber.new do
  i = 1
  while i <= n
    Fiber.yield i
    i += 1
  end
end
loop do
  v = f.resume
  break if v.nil?
  puts v
end

questions.title: Thread Lifecycle Three Returns

Line 1: three space-separated integers a b c.

Output Format:
Three lines: a*a, b*b, c*c.

questions.title: Warehouse Pallet Counter
questions.description:
A warehouse has two workers tallying pallet IDs. Worker A handles pallets 1..k and worker B handles pallets k+1..n, where k = (n+1)/2. Each worker sums their assigned pallet IDs and adds the result to a shared total under a mutex. Join both workers, then print the total pallet count.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n (total pallets).

Output Format:
The sum 1 + 2 + ... + n.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
half = (n + 1) / 2
total = 0
mutex = Mutex.new
t1 = Thread.new do
  s = 0
  (1..half).each { |x| s += x }
  mutex.synchronize { total += s }
end
t2 = Thread.new do
  s = 0
  ((half + 1)..n).each { |x| s += x }
  mutex.synchronize { total += s }
end
t1.join
t2.join

questions.title: Bank Account Mutex Deposit
questions.description:
A bank account starts with balance 0. Read deposit amount d and teller count t. Spawn t threads; each teller deposits d into the shared balance under a mutex. Join all tellers, then print the final balance.

Input Format:
Line 1: integers d and t.

Output Format:
The final balance d * t.

Constraints:
1 <= d <= 1000; 1 <= t <= 100.
questions.sourcecode:
d, t = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
balance = 0
mutex = Mutex.new
threads = t.times.map do
  Thread.new do
    mutex.synchronize { balance += d }
  end
end
threads.each(&:join)
puts balance

questions.title: Fiber Even Number Stream
questions.description:
A monitoring dashboard streams even numbers from 2 up to n. Use a Fiber that yields each even value (2, 4, 6, ...) up to and including n. Resume repeatedly and print each yielded value on its own line.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n (even, >= 2).

Output Format:
One even number per line from 2 up to n.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 1000; n is even.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
f = Fiber.new do
  i = 2
  while i <= n
    Fiber.yield i
    i += 2
  end
end
loop do
  v = f.resume
  break if v.nil?
  puts v
end

questions.title: Parallel Image Pixel Sum
questions.description:
An image is a matrix of r rows and c columns of pixel intensities. Split the rows in half: thread A handles rows 0..k-1, thread B handles rows k..r-1, where k = (r+1)/2. Each thread sums all pixels in its rows and adds the partial sum to a shared total under a mutex. Join both threads, then print the total pixel sum.

Input Format:
Line 1: r and c. Next r lines: c space-separated integers each.

Output Format:
The sum of all pixel values.

Constraints:
1 <= r, c <= 100; 0 <= pixel <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
r, c = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
matrix = []
r.times { matrix << gets.split.map(&:to_i) }
half = (r + 1) / 2
total = 0
mutex = Mutex.new
t1 = Thread.new do
  s = 0
  (0...half).each do |i|
    matrix[i].each { |v| s += v }
  end
  mutex.synchronize { total += s }
end
t2 = Thread.new do
  s = 0
  (half...r).each do |i|
    matrix[i].each { |v| s += v }
  end
  mutex.synchronize { total += s }
end
t1.join
t2.join
puts total

questions.title: Concurrent Inventory Hash Merge
questions.description:
An inventory snapshot lists n items as 'name qty' pairs. Two clerks split the list in half; each builds a partial hash of name to qty, then merges their hash into a shared result hash under a mutex. Names are unique. Join both clerks, then print 'name qty' lines sorted by name.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: name and qty space-separated.

Output Format:
n lines sorted by name, each 'name qty'.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100; names are unique lowercase strings; 1 <= qty <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
items = []
n.times do
  name, qty = gets.split
  items << [name, qty.to_i]
end
half = (n + 1) / 2
result = {}
mutex = Mutex.new
t1 = Thread.new do
  partial = {}
  (0...half).each do |i|
    name, qty = items[i]
    partial[name] = qty
  end
  mutex.synchronize { partial.each { |k, v| result[k] = v } }
end
t2 = Thread.new do
  partial = {}
  (half...n).each do |i|
    name, qty = items[i]
    partial[name] = qty
  end
  mutex.synchronize { partial.each { |k, v| result[k] = v } }
end
t1.join
t2.join
keys = result.keys.sort
keys.each { |k| puts "#{k} #{result[k]}" }

questions.title: Producer Consumer Even Sum Queue
questions.description:
A sensor pipeline reads n integer readings. A producer thread pushes each reading into a Queue, then a sentinel nil. A consumer thread pops readings and adds only the even ones to a shared total under a mutex. Join both threads, then print the total of even readings.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: one integer reading each.

Output Format:
The sum of even-valued readings.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100; -1000 <= reading <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
values = []
n.times { values << gets.to_i }
q = Queue.new
total = 0
mutex = Mutex.new
producer = Thread.new do
  values.each { |v| q.push(v) }
  q.push(nil)
end
consumer = Thread.new do
  loop do
    v = q.pop
    break if v.nil?
    if v % 2 == 0
      mutex.synchronize { total += v }
    end
  end
end
producer.join
consumer.join
puts total

questions.title: Fiber Fibonacci Stream
questions.description:
A trading feed generates the first n Fibonacci numbers (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, ...). Use a Fiber that yields each Fibonacci number until n have been yielded. Resume the fiber n times and print each value on its own line.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n.

Output Format:
n lines, each containing one Fibonacci number starting from 1.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 50.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
f = Fiber.new do
  a, b = 1, 1
  count = 0
  while count < n
    Fiber.yield a
    a, b = b, a + b
    count += 1
  end
end
loop do
  v = f.resume
  break if v.nil?
  puts v
end

questions.title: Parallel Matrix Row Maximums
questions.description:
A grid of sensor readings has r rows and c columns. Split rows in half: thread A scans rows 0..k-1, thread B scans rows k..r-1, where k = (r+1)/2. Each thread tracks the largest value in its rows and updates the global max under a mutex. Join both threads, then print the overall maximum.

Input Format:
Line 1: r and c. Next r lines: c space-separated integers each.

Output Format:
The maximum value in the grid.

Constraints:
1 <= r, c <= 100; 0 <= value <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
r, c = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
matrix = []
r.times { matrix << gets.split.map(&:to_i) }
half = (r + 1) / 2
max_val = -1
mutex = Mutex.new
t1 = Thread.new do
  m = -1
  (0...half).each do |i|
    matrix[i].each { |v| m = v if v > m }
  end
  mutex.synchronize { max_val = m if m > max_val }
end
t2 = Thread.new do
  m = -1
  (half...r).each do |i|
    matrix[i].each { |v| m = v if v > m }
  end
  mutex.synchronize { max_val = m if m > max_val }
end
t1.join
t2.join
puts max_val

questions.title: Thread Pool Word Counter
questions.description:
A document archive contains n lines of text. Two indexer threads split the lines in half; each counts space-separated words in its slice and adds the count to a shared total under a mutex. Join both threads, then print the total word count.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: arbitrary text (no leading/trailing spaces).

Output Format:
The total number of space-separated words across all lines.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100; each line has length 1..200.
questions.input2:
4
alpha beta
gamma
delta epsilon zeta
eta
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
lines = []
n.times { lines << gets.chomp }
half = (n + 1) / 2
total = 0
mutex = Mutex.new
t1 = Thread.new do
  cnt = 0
  (0...half).each do |i|
    parts = lines[i].split
    parts.each { cnt += 1 }
  end
  mutex.synchronize { total += cnt }
end
t2 = Thread.new do
  cnt = 0
  (half...n).each do |i|
    parts = lines[i].split
    parts.each { cnt += 1 }
  end
  mutex.synchronize { total += cnt }
end
t1.join
t2.join
puts total

questions.title: Multi-Producer Multi-Consumer Pipeline
questions.description:
A batch processor receives n task values. Spawn two producer threads that each push half of the values into a shared Queue, followed by a nil sentinel each. Spawn two consumer threads that pop values, square them, and add to a shared total under a mutex. Join all four threads, then print the total of squared values.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: one integer value each.

Output Format:
The sum of squares of the n values.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100; -1000 <= value <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
values = []
n.times { values << gets.to_i }
half = (n + 1) / 2
q = Queue.new
total = 0
mutex = Mutex.new
p1 = Thread.new do
  (0...half).each { |i| q.push(values[i]) }
  q.push(nil)
end
p2 = Thread.new do
  (half...n).each { |i| q.push(values[i]) }
  q.push(nil)
end
c1 = Thread.new do
  loop do
    v = q.pop
    break if v.nil?
    mutex.synchronize { total += v * v }
  end
end
c2 = Thread.new do
  loop do
    v = q.pop
    break if v.nil?
    mutex.synchronize { total += v * v }
  end
end
p1.join
p2.join
c1.join
c2.join
puts total

questions.title: Parallel Prime Range Counter
questions.description:
Count the prime numbers in the inclusive range [lo, hi]. Split the range in half at mid = (lo+hi)/2. Thread A checks lo..mid, thread B checks mid+1..hi. Each thread counts primes in its slice using trial division and adds to a shared total under a mutex. Join both threads, then print the total prime count.

Input Format:
Line 1: integers lo and hi.

Output Format:
The number of primes in [lo, hi].

Constraints:
1 <= lo <= hi <= 10000.
questions.sourcecode:
lo, hi = gets.split.map(&:to_i)
mid = (lo + hi) / 2
total = 0
mutex = Mutex.new
is_prime = ->(x) {
  return false if x < 2
  i = 2
  while i * i <= x
    return false if x % i == 0
    i += 1
  end
  true
}
t1 = Thread.new do
  cnt = 0
  (lo..mid).each { |x| cnt += 1 if is_prime.call(x) }
  mutex.synchronize { total += cnt }
end
t2 = Thread.new do
  cnt = 0
  ((mid + 1)..hi).each { |x| cnt += 1 if is_prime.call(x) }
  mutex.synchronize { total += cnt }
end
t1.join
t2.join
puts total

questions.title: Fiber Collatz Sequence Generator
questions.description:
Read a positive integer n. Use a Fiber that yields successive values of the Collatz sequence starting from n: if x is even, next is x/2; if odd (and > 1), next is 3*x+1; stops at 1. Resume the fiber repeatedly and print each yielded value on its own line.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n.

Output Format:
One value per line, the full Collatz sequence from n down to 1.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
f = Fiber.new do
  x = n
  loop do
    Fiber.yield x
    break if x == 1
    x = x.even? ? x / 2 : 3 * x + 1
  end
end
loop do
  v = f.resume
  break if v.nil?
  puts v
end

questions.title: Concurrent Bank Account Ledger
questions.description:
A bank account starts with balance 100. Read n transactions, each 'deposit X' or 'withdraw X'. Two teller threads split the transaction list in half; each computes its net change (deposits positive, withdrawals negative) and applies it to the shared balance under a mutex. Join both threads, then print the final balance.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: 'deposit X' or 'withdraw X'.

Output Format:
The final balance after all transactions.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100; 1 <= X <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
n = gets.to_i
txns = []
n.times { txns << gets.chomp.split }
balance = 100
mutex = Mutex.new
half = (n + 1) / 2
t1 = Thread.new do
  bal = 0
  (0...half).each do |i|
    op, amt = txns[i][0], txns[i][1].to_i
    bal += amt if op == "deposit"
    bal -= amt if op == "withdraw"
  end
  mutex.synchronize { balance += bal }
end
t2 = Thread.new do
  bal = 0
  (half...n).each do |i|
    op, amt = txns[i][0], txns[i][1].to_i
    bal += amt if op == "deposit"
    bal -= amt if op == "withdraw"
  end
  mutex.synchronize { balance += bal }
end
t1.join
t2.join
puts balance
